items.reason: Forced rebind prompts can print before the Drain header.
Whole-set Implement supplies the header even inside the bound checkout.
The header uses the resolved checkout root, losing the actual invocation directory when invoked from a subdirectory.
BoundDefault adds the required binding-recorded line.
The old bound-checkout report is removed.
Single-task runs print the current checkout path without a Drain header.
Successful tasks print one green done result line.
Implementation-commit details print directly below the done line.
Whole-set completion no longer prints the old Completed line or duplicates the result.
Exhausted task failures print one red failed line and retain the failed state.
Agent exhaustion after contract failures or overruns still prints failed and leaves the task failed.
Quota pauses print the yellow quota-paused line with the selected preset.
Interrupts during quota recovery return without an interrupted Task result line.
Blocked and Deferred remain set-level reports; executed tasks receive separate result lines.
Attempt failures, attempt breakdowns, and exhausted-walk reports remain.
The shared output writer prints complete plain-text lines for redirected output.
The shared output writer applies terminal styles and suppresses them with NO_COLOR.
Header and result rendering add no Work journal writes.

scores.rationale: Clear output helpers and useful tests, but invocation-path accuracy, interruption coverage, and some acceptance cases remain incomplete.
